Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary
For the Petitioner : Mr. Amit Kr. Das , Adv.
For the State : Mr. P.D. Agrawal, Spl. PP 12 / 17.01.2024 I.A. No. 9669 of 2023 Heard the parties

. 
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to amend this criminal miscellaneous petition by incorporating proposed amendment as mentioned in para 5 of this interlocutory application as additional prayer in para 1 and prayer portion of this criminal miscellaneous petition.

It is further submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the amendment is necessitated because during pendency of this criminal miscellaneous petition vide order dated 01.09.2023, learned CJM, Palamu at Daltonganj framed the charges against the petitioner for having committed the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC.

Considering the aforesaid facts, the prayer is allowed and the petitioner is directed to file consolidated criminal miscellaneous petition along with the certified copy of form of heading of charge, within two weeks, failing which, this criminal miscellaneous application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
This interlocutory application is disposed of accordingly.
(ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays to implead the informant as opposite party no. 2.
Prayer is allowed.

Issue notice to the Opposite Party no. 2.

The petitioner is directed to file requisites of notice through both processes i.e. under registered post with A/D as well as through ordinary process within one week, failing which, this criminal miscellaneous petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
Rule is made returnable within six weeks.
List this case after receipt of the service report of the notice issued to opposite party no. 2.

(ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.) Smita/-
